scope: Contextual reference and boundary-velocity-preserving learned correction ablations
calibration: Artificial frame zero in the existing corpus only; excluded from motion observations and targets
holdouts: Only train/validation used in initial selection and reproduction; earlier confirmation is already observed and must never be labeled fresh
label_policy: Only four known poses (or two without context) enter observations; full targets are separate trainer labels
physics_policy: Collapsed semantic edges are not asserted to have constant length; raw baselines do not qualify actual rig physics
next: Evaluate selected compatible predictions on actual-rig editable actions; failed gates forbid promotion
selection: Four training-only catalog-prefix folds, excluding complete groups. Minimum pooled out-of-fold raw position + 0.1*rotation selects one learned specification; fit once on all training windows and freeze model hash before loading validation. Compare this single candidate with identical projected baselines; no validation-driven retuning.
reproduction: Repeat all sixteen internal neural fits, final fit and fixed validation comparison; exact serialized model bytes and metrics.
runtime: Local NumPy float64 training and inference; no new assets, subscriptions, APIs or downloads
projection_method: Fixed 48-step projected Adam with eight bounded quarter-step backtracking attempts; exact root, terminal orientations and known priorities
fold_group: CMU catalog prefix before underscore, not asserted to be independent actor identity
objective: Same v14 trajectory/derivative neural objective, differentiated through per-observation channel amplitudes. No division by tiny amplitudes; zero-amplitude channels have zero correction gradients.
training_only_diagnostics: Retain epoch objectives and learned hidden-feature changes. Finite-difference gradients and zero-regularization feature-learning test precede corpus fitting. No architecture, epoch or regularization retuning after validation.
architecture: Same observed-motion scaling and local64-unit tanh model as selected v15; four frozen reference/envelope ablations, training-only grouped selection, no architecture/epoch/quality retuning.
residual_scale: Per semantic joint: endpoint positional distance or rotation-matrix Frobenius distance/sqrt(2), plus half duration times incoming/outgoing speed when context is present. Repeat position amplitude for three position channels and rotation amplitude for six rotation channels. No hidden labels, threshold floor or post-validation clipping. Use unit-duration four-term temporal basis; multiply learned coefficients by observed amplitudes in both training and prediction.
stationary_acceptance: Identical observed endpoints/context yield exactly zero raw residual. Near-stationary residual approaches zero continuously. Actual stationary rig positions/orientation matrices remain within existing 2e-5 host numerical tolerance across generated frames, including source recovery.
reference_policy: Linear or existing known-context Cartesian/quaternion Hermite reference; both reduce to the existing line/SLERP when context is absent. Learn labels relative to that same reference.
continuity_policy: C0 uses4*t*(1-t)*Legendre terms. C1 multiplies by4*t*(1-t), giving zero correction and zero first derivative at both authored priorities. This preserves reference proposal derivatives, not an unproven guarantee about nonlinear physical projection.
optimizer: Adam proposals with at most eight half-step attempts; require finite non-increasing batch objective or retain old parameters. Momentum advances even on rejected proposals. This pre-fit repair is recorded in results/boundary-trajectory-prefit-correction-v16.json.
